name: Memory Rondo
descriptionTemplate: Obtain [Power:Arg1] {STR}. Add 2 {derived:Insight} to your hand. If you lack the required Arithmetica, you can still play this card, but its effect will be changed to shuffle 2 {derived:Insight} cards into your Draw Pile.
lore: Have you heard this melody before? It feels so familiar and intimate, evoking the echoes of a lifetime. Where could you have heard it? In your dreams, in your memories, or in the celestial call before death, softly played by an angelic flutist.
